hooks.name: Doc Claims Scan
hooks.description: When a Rust source is saved, notes any doc-comment (/// or //!) that references a backticked snake_case identifier with no matching fn/struct/enum/const/trait/type/macro definition in rustconn-core/src or rustconn/src — the 'doc lies' class from the 0.22.12 audit (search_parallel, etc.). Command hook, zero model cost; a NOTE to the shared session report, never a block, because a method-only or field-only name can false-positive. Silent when clean. Fails open. Logic: bin/doc-claims-scan.sh.
